slides.title:
The Moon meets
Saturn in Pisces
slides.subtitle: Friday afternoon, about 3:45 PM

slides.label: Friday 20 November
slides.title:
Two grahas,
one sign
body: At about 3:45 PM Toronto time, the mother (the Moon) passes the auditor (Saturn) in Pisces.
slides.closing: In one sign, two grahas act on each other at full strength

items.head: The Moon in Pisces
items.line: Soft, kind and a little dreamy. Pisces is the teacher’s sign, Jupiter’s.

items.head: Saturn in Pisces
items.line: Walking backward since July, forward again on 10 December. Walking backward, the auditor rechecks old work.

slides.label: Together
slides.title:
A mood that wants
a job done
body: The mind and duty sit in one room, and together they make a heavy mood that wants one job done.

slides.label: Nadi rule 6
slides.title: The king is family
body: The king (the Sun) sits in Scorpio, another water sign. Signs 5th and 9th apart act together, so he is family.

slides.label: In real life
slides.title: This evening
items: Let a feeling be, instead of rushing to fix it
